budget_items.topic: Turf field user fees paid to the town
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The main turf field users (Lunenburg Schools, LYSA Soccer, Bengals Football) had been paying a combined total of $25K in user fees each year, which went to pay down the lease; the lease is now complete and fee collection is unclear.
budget_items.quote: had been paying a combined total of $25k in user fees each year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Turf field and track will need complete reconditioning, suggested for 2017, with estimated cost possibly near $800K.
Lighting cost for the site will be addressed with the new school; a generator is currently on site for night games. No figure given.
budget_items.quote: future lighting cost will be addressed in conjunction with the new school.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Little League may fund the erosion project between the softball field and lower Powell field; Dan Proctor feels Little League has the funds. Detailed plans with funding values including labor and materials were requested. No figure given.
budget_items.quote: dan proctor has also been consulted and he feels that little league has the funds to complete this project.
